name: phone
label: Phone
help: Include the country code, e.g. +14155550142. Required if Email is left blank.

name: email
label: Email
help: Required if Phone is left blank.

name: external_id
label: External ID
help: Strongly recommended: map a unique ID for this customer from whatever app triggered this scenario — a CRM record ID, an order number, a row ID. If this module ever runs twice for the same customer (Make's own automatic retry after a rate limit or timeout, or a manual re-run from the scenario history), sending the same External ID returns the contact ReviewEngine already created instead of creating a duplicate. Leave blank only if this scenario will never plausibly run twice for the same person.
